ranking_contract.score: largest candidate_triples_blocked value observed for any member of a root-symmetry triple orbit
ranking_contract.persistence: scores are stored by canonical root-symmetry orbit representative in triple-coverability.json and restored on a resumed run
ranking_contract.selection: encode the highest-scoring complete orbit; ties prefer the most recently accumulated orbit
ranking_contract.soundness: Every unencoded triple and every quadruple obligation remains subject to the exact lazy audit before any GCTS continuation.

interpretation: Impact ranking is persistent and mechanically effective: after the first measured triple obstruction, the encoded orbit changes to the 110-combination orbit on the next solve and remains selected after restart. All six proposals are nevertheless rejected by exact pair or triple audits, and solve time remains 186-325 seconds per proposal. Ranking therefore improves steering but does not escape the current defect basin; retaining solver state or otherwise reducing repeated outer-model construction is the next performance target.
